description: Publish a draft listing to the marketplace. Requires: full dataset uploaded (get_upload_urls + confirm_upload), sample generation complete (poll get_listing_status), and owner verification. Requires documentation.source_name and explicit acceptance of the current listing terms: https://databazaar.io/legal/terms#dataset-reuse. Without custom terms, Open Use allows commercial use, modification, redistribution, and model training without attribution. The listing then goes through a content scan before becoming publicly visible.

dataset_id.description: The draft dataset ID to publish

listing_terms_version.description: Version of listing terms explicitly accepted by the supplier

tos_confirmed.description: Confirm authorization to accept https://databazaar.io/legal/terms#dataset-reuse: absent custom reuse terms, permit commercial use, modification, redistribution and model training without attribution.

name: publish_listing
